Here’s a quick snapshot of some of the most notable players who have worn the Los Angeles Clippers jersey over the years—both past legends and recent stars:

| Era | Notable Players (selected) |
|-----|----------------------------|
| **Early Years (1970s‑1980s)** | *Moses Malone* (drafted 1974), *Kenny Smith*, *Bobby Phills* |
| **1990s** | *Gary Payton* (1997‑98), *Chris Webber* (1998‑99), *Julius Erving* (brief stint 1999) |
| **2000s** | *Blake Griffin* (2009‑2015), *DeAndre Jordan* (2009‑2019), *Chris Paul* (2013‑2017) |
| **2010s‑Present** | *Paul George* (2013‑2022), *Kawhi Leonard* (2019‑present), *Reggie Jackson* (2020‑present), *Jamal Crawford* (2021‑present) |
| **Current Roster (2025‑26)** | *Paul George*, *Kawhi Leonard*, *Reggie Jackson*, *Jamal Crawford*, *Jalen Green*, *Cameron Johnson*, *Jabari Smith Jr.*, *Darius Miles*, *Jalen McDaniels*, *Jalen Smith*, *Jalen Green*, *Jabari Smith Jr.* (and others) |

> **Quick Take:**  
> - **Blake Griffin** was the face of the franchise during its “Lob City” era.  
> - **Chris Paul** helped elevate the team’s competitiveness in the early 2010s.  
> - **Paul George** and **Kawhi Leonard** have been the cornerstone of the Clippers’ recent playoff runs.  
> - The current lineup blends veteran leadership (George, Leonard, Crawford) with young talent (Green, Johnson, Smith Jr.).

If you’re looking for a deeper dive into a specific decade or want a full roster history, let me know!
